metadata.title: Observation Discriminant and Spherical Fold Image of the Orthogonal-Circle Ruled Surface
metadata.description: We determine the full critical locus of the planar observation map attached to the orthogonal-circle ruled surface. Its Jacobian factors into a symmetry component and signed rational arms. We distinguish the planar observation discriminant from the normalized spherical radial image, identify the ordinary-fold regime and exceptional common point, and provide exact polynomial identities, Sturm counts, and numerical checks. The accompanying Lean companion formally verifies the stated algebraic and root certificates; it does not claim a complete formalization of the plane-to-plane Whitney-fold theorem.
